Package hadur117.core.melee

Class MeleeEndgame

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.MeleeEndgame
public final class MeleeEndgame extends Object
Melee Stage 1 (docs/plan-melee-top5.md): Hadur's play with two opponents left, off a team.

The Stage 0 census (PR #292) found Hadur dies with two opponents left in 12.8% of rounds, the largest share of its deaths, and enters the last duel behind on energy against every survivor ranked 1-30. Today two opponents left already plays as the duel will: the endgame ring and lateral weight (MMOVE-4) and the duel's power table (MGUN-2). Each switch below keeps the crowd's play for that phase instead. MEND-3 is on (banked with MGUN-7's 24 by the bank card, BENCH-115); the other two are off, and the bench builds an arm with one turned on (build-ablation.sh e3ring, e3pow).

None applies on a team, nor with one opponent left, so team battles and the duel (and with it every 1v1 battle) are untouched.
